mechanic.rpgclasses.race_adaptable.desc: Reduces the chosen wall and the negative base traits of your class.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_adaptable.name: Adaptable
The anvil costs you fewer levels.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_aquatic.desc: You mine underwater at normal speed and see underwater. Fire hurts you more.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_aquatic.name: Water Creature
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_arcane.desc: Improved enchanting table and Arcane Fusion.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_arcane.name: Arcane Lore
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_auto_smelt.desc: Ores you mine come out smelted.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_auto_smelt.name: Smelting Touch
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_barter.desc: Chance for bartering with piglins to give double.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_barter.name: Infernal Deal
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_blast_proof.des: Explosions you cause do not hurt you.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_bones.desc: Neutral skeletons and less projectile damage.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_bones.name: Bones
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_camouflage.name: Camouflage
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_cave_eyes.desc: Night vision without skylight; immune to Darkness.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_cave_eyes.name: Cave Eyes
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_cold_frailty.de: Cold (freezing and ice spells) and water (water spells from T.O Magic 'n Extras) hurt you more.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_dead_regen.desc: You constantly regenerate health; it stops when you take damage.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_dead_regen.name: Dead Regeneration
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_devour.desc: Killing an enemy grants hunger and saturation.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_devour.name: Devour
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_escort.name: Escort
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_ethereal.desc: You cannot take damage or attack.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_ethereal.name: Ethereal Form
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_feast.desc: When you kill a hostile mob or a boss you randomly gain Strength, Resistance or Regeneration I for as many seconds as its maximum health (bosses) or a fraction of it (others).
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_feast.name: Feast
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_fire_immune.des: Immune to fire and lava (not to magical fire damage). Milk does not remove it.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_fisher.name: Expert Fishing
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_fixed_hunger.de: Your hunger neither rises nor falls and you have no saturation.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_flame_pool.desc: Your racial Magma Bomb leaves flames that burn enemies.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_flame_pool.name: Flame Pool
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_flexible_respec: The XP lost on reset is reduced by the Adaptable percentage.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_forest_regen.de: From Rank 2, you have Regeneration I in forest biomes.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_forge_heat.name: Forge Heat
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_forged.desc: Things you craft or repair last longer; at Rank 3 things you craft come out with extra Unbreaking.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_forged.name: Dwarven Forge
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_forged_armor.de: From Rank 2, each armor piece you crafted that you wear gives +0.5 toughness.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_fortune.desc: Fortune level on ores (never with Silk Touch).
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_fortune.name: Racial Fortune
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_green_touch.des: Right-click with an empty hand: free bone meal on a crop.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_harvest.name: Bountiful Harvest
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_hunger.name: Orc Appetite
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_iron_stomach.de: Raw meat and fish without negative effects; they fill you as if cooked.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_last_stand.desc: You survive a lethal hit with 1 HP, once per life. Resolves after class abilities and before the Totem.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_last_stand.name: Last Stand
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_lava_pool.desc: Your racial Magma Bomb leaves lava that burns and slows enemies.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_lava_pool.name: Lava Pool
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_lava_walk.desc: You walk on lava (crouching sinks you).
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_lava_walk.name: Lavawalker
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_leaf_walker.des: You pass through leaves and climb them.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_lifeless.desc: Healing potions and healing spells do not heal you.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_lifeless.name: Lifeless Body
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_long_hand.desc: Chance to steal when hitting in melee.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_long_hand.name: Light Fingers
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_looting.desc: Looting level (the higher of this and the enchantment counts).
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_looting.name: Racial Looting
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_miner.desc: Extra speed when breaking stone and ores.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_miner.name: Miner
Locates the nearest fortress or bastion.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_nether_weakness: In the Nether you have Weakness.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_no_meat.desc: You cannot eat meat or fish.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_no_meat.name: Elven Diet
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_outcast.desc: Iron golems are always hostile and villagers charge more.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_outcast.name: Marked
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_piercing_fire.d: Your racial Fire Shot pierces enemies.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_plant_food.desc: Food that is neither meat nor fish fills you more.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_plant_food.name: Plant Diet
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_portable_furnac: Instantly smelts what you hold in hand using fuel from your inventory.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_racial_spells.d: Level of each racial fire spell (0 = you don't have it yet). Requires Iron's Spells.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_scholar.desc: From Rank 2, enemies you defeat give 15% more experience.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_scholar.name: Scholar
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_sea_friend.name: Friend of the Sea
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_searing_strikes: From Rank 2, your melee hits set the target on fire for 2 s.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_second_wall.des: A second wall receives part of the reduction.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_smoke_cloud.des: A cloud that makes everything inside it invisible.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_snare.desc: A trap that never expires: the first enemy to step on it takes damage and is immobilized. Only you can see it.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_snare.name: Snare
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_sunburn.desc: Direct sunlight damages you (ignores armor) and cancels your regeneration.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_sunburn.name: Sunlight
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_tame_water.desc: Creates a temporary water source where you aim.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_tame_water.name: Tame Water
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_thick_skin.desc: Damage subtracted from every hit you take.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_thick_skin.name: Thick Skin
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_thirst.desc: Healing on kill and life steal.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_thirst.name: Thirst
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_trident_mastery: From Rank 2, the trident (melee or thrown) deals 25% more damage.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_tunnel.desc: Crouching, you mine stone in a 3×3 tunnel at a higher hunger cost.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_tunnel.name: Tunnel
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_vein_miner.desc: When you break an ore you break the connected ores of the same type.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_vein_miner.name: Veins
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_wall_mastery.de: Multiplies the reduction of the main wall.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_warcry.desc: Purges Slowness, Weakness, Blindness, Fatigue, Nausea and Darkness in the radius.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_warcry.name: Warlord's Voice
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_water_scald.des: While you are in water you slowly burn.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_water_wall.desc: A temporary 3×3 wall of water in front of you.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_water_wall.name: Water Wall
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_wave.desc: Pushes the enemies in front of you, without damage.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_wave.name: Wave
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_weightless.desc: No fall damage and slow falling.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_weightless.name: Weightless
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_wolf_bite.desc: The wolf you ride bites whatever you hit.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_wolf_bite.name: Bite
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_wolf_mount.desc: You ride your tamed wolves (right-click with an empty hand).
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_wolf_mount.name: Rider
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_wolf_regen.desc: The wolf you ride has Regeneration.
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_wolf_regen.name: Bond
mechanic.rpgclasses.race_wolf_vigor.name: Strong Wolves
mechanic.rpgclasses.resistant_blood.name: Resistant Blood
mechanic.rpgclasses.retreat.name: Retreat
mechanic.rpgclasses.shield_counter.name: Shield Counter
mechanic.rpgclasses.shockwave.name: Shockwave
mechanic.rpgclasses.smite.name: Smite
mechanic.rpgclasses.spirit_skin.name: Spirit Skin
mechanic.rpgclasses.stance_affinity.name: Stance Body Affinity
mechanic.rpgclasses.stance_mastery.name: Discharge and Stance Effect Efficacy
mechanic.rpgclasses.steady_flame.name: Steady Flame
mechanic.rpgclasses.steady_shooter.name: Steady Shooter
mechanic.rpgclasses.stealth_drain.name: Stealth Drain
mechanic.rpgclasses.sticky_arrow.name: Sticky Arrow
mechanic.rpgclasses.stone_echo.name: Stone Echo
mechanic.rpgclasses.stone_potency.name: Stone Charge Potency
mechanic.rpgclasses.summon_bonus.name: Reinforced Summons
mechanic.rpgclasses.summon_count.name: Summons per Spell
mechanic.rpgclasses.tenacity.name: Tenacity
mechanic.rpgclasses.toxin.name: Toxin
mechanic.rpgclasses.toxin_variant.name: Toxin Dose
mechanic.rpgclasses.wall_mitigation.name: Harmony (reduces walls)
mechanic.rpgclasses.war_banner.name: War Banner
